newsitem.title: USA: Weirton Steel has tentative labor pact.
newsitem.headline: Weirton Steel has tentative labor pact.

text.p: Weirton Steel Corp said it reached a tentative agreement Thursday evening with the Independent Steelworkers Union on a 4-1/2-year labor contract.
The accord covers nearly 4,000 production and maintenance workers, the company said. Specifics of the settlement were not immediately available.

It said the union's 34-member steward body must approve the agreement by a two-thirds vote before sending it to the remaining membership for ratification. A simple majority is required for ratification and the start of the contract would be retroactive from September 26, 1996.

The company said its negotiators will now seek contract agreements with three other bargaining units which in total represent 560 additional employees. The three include the professional/nursing staffs, Independent Guard Union and Salary Non-Exempt personnel.
